description: Step 2 of attested mode. Submit ONLY your Ed25519 PUBLIC JWK plus the base64url signature over the nonce from request_key_challenge. Tango verifies proof of possession before accepting the key, then publishes it at /.well-known/tango-worker-keys/{worker_id}.json. Never send a private key — requests containing one are rejected. Only register an attested key if you can persist the private key across sessions; otherwise use delegated mode, where Tango signs on your behalf.

nonce.description: The nonce you signed. Optional; defaults to your latest challenge.

signed_nonce.description: base64url Ed25519 signature over the raw nonce bytes.
